protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed CWE-862 IDOR: profile is excluded from validate_role, accepts an authenticated caller-controlled user_id, resolves that other user's object, and renders edit without an ownership or users-management authorization check. The route exists as GET admin/profile.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 3415939272499a06c64d6ae8f641e4a9cfca43ba as the smallest public first-write of the vulnerable lookup. Exact-string history shows this commit introduced current_site.the_user(params[:user_id].to_i).object; later hits are a RuboCop rewrite and the fix.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed immediate parent 083fa8a7170f96f83fa8cfbe391957f579f220db has the same validate_role exemption but profile assigns only current_user.object; the attacker-controlled cross-user lookup is absent. The BIC-to-parent controller diff is the one-line assignment change.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: The BIC is a single-parent 41-file aggregate, not a merge. No finer public member is exposed by the clone refs; the exact vulnerable hunk first exists in this surviving commit, so there is no reconstructable member to substitute or decompose.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed the BIC is an ancestor of tag 2.9.2, while patch merge ae10da7cfce902a8552927c57b0a562fb1676040 is not. The 2.9.2 tree retains the unauthorised user_id lookup, matching CVE.org's affected range 0 through 2.9.2.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed both the BIC and patch merge ae10da7cfce902a8552927c57b0a562fb1676040 are ancestors of tag 2.9.3; the 2.9.3 tree performs authorization before the cross-user load. CVE.org identifies ae10da7 as unaffected/patch.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 1fa227bc5a6246ef47469094380a7d2ebb76c24d adds authorize! :manage, :users for a requested non-self profile. It is an ancestor of PR merge ae10da7cfce902a8552927c57b0a562fb1676040, whose first-parent diff contains that guard.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed on BIC object only: author and committer are Owen <owenperedo@gmail.com>, dated 2015-10-17, with one parent, no trailers, no bot identity, and no Generated-by/Generated-with/Co-Authored-By marker. Later remediation commits are excluded from attribution.

findings: CVE-2026-56720 is currently PUBLISHED in the CVE.org record, not rejected or withdrawn; its mechanism, affected range, and patch reference agree with the frozen advisory bundle.

The older validate_role exemption alone was not the vulnerability because the parent loaded only the current user; the BIC is the later first-write that combined the exemption with arbitrary user_id lookup.
The primary causal chain, release gates, direct fix, and BIC-only human attribution independently reproduce from the permitted clone and advisory evidence.
